body.cap: Tramontina Guru on display at the booth | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Tramontina debuted its Smart Cooking solution Guru at CES 2023 - guiding and motivating home cooks step by step from preparation to plating a perfect meal. Tramontina stated that cooking is both craftwork and science - demanding exact measures, timing, temperatures, and ingenious flavor combinations to satisfy the taste. It designed the machine to help cookers make a great meal that takes time and attention, risking minor mistakes that may ruin the food. CES participants observed chefs demonstrating Tramontina Guru's versatility and capabilities through real-time cooking throughout the exhibition.

body.cap: Chefs in Tramontina's booth made cheese fondue with Guru smart cooker | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Tramontina Guru starter kit has an advanced portable induction cooktop with an integrated temperature sensor and scale, reflexive display and touch buttons, and a Bluetooth connection to pair with a smartphone app. Tramontina says that cooks can use this exclusive app to access more than 200 recipes and step-by-step instructions while controlling and monitoring the cooktop remotely. The app is available for iOS and Android devices and offers recipes with text and video directions, chef tips, and nutritional information. Tramontina formulated all recipes with Guru and compatible cookware and accessories for better consistency in produced foods.

body.cap: Tramontina Guru Starter Set | Photo by Tramontina

body.x: The Guru starter kit also contains a 4-quart stainless steel saucepan with a lid, a 9.5-inch ceramic nonstick frying pan, a set of gauging spoons, and a small ruler for precise ingredient measurement. Cooks can buy extra cookware, silicone utensils, cutlery, prep boards, bowls, and other accessories on Tramontina's website. Tramontina expects Guru will allow home cooks to impress their family and friends with a connected cooker and will sharpen their culinary skills.

body.cap: Overview of the Tramontina booth | Photo by AVING News

body.x: "Top chefs know precision in the kitchen ... guarantees a great meal," said Chef Elzio Callefi Junior. "Tramontina Guru is a game changer for home cooks because precision ... built into the smart cooker with the integrated temperature sensor and scale, plus recipes thoughtfully developed to ensure greater control over quantities, cooking time, and temperature. With a connected cooking approach, home cooks can get chef-quality results without having to be a culinary expert."

body.cap: Tramontina Guru on display | Photo by AVING News

body.x: "Tramontina Guru will change the way people prepare great meals and cook with their friends and family, improving the cooking experience by combining top-quality cookware with digital innovation and connectivity so modern cooks can consistently produce chef-quality results," said Marcelo Borges, President, and CEO of Tramontina USA. "This smart cooker helps home cooks improve their culinary skills and gain confidence when cooking for others. It's the future of cooking, and everyone at CES who loves to cook (or loves someone who loves to cook) should stop by our booth to check it out."
